Done — solved on the first execution.

**Approach:** plain `safetensors` + `torch` script (`out/T2/solution.py`), not `transformers.prune_heads`. Grading is bit-exact on keys/shapes/dtypes/values, and `prune_heads` would rewrite the fused projection through its own bookkeeping plus re-save the whole model — no control over the exact row order the spec demands.

**The two layout traps:**
- The fused `query_key_value` is GPT-NeoX *interleaved*, so head 5 is one contiguous 768-row cut at `3840..4607` — not three separate 256-row cuts into `[q|k|v]` segments.
- `attention.dense` is `[out, in]`, so heads are 256-wide *column* blocks: cut on dim 1 at `1280..1535`.

**Checks (raise before writing):** the three layer-0 shapes `[5376,2048]` / `[5376]` / `[2048,1792]`, tensor count == 244, count unchanged vs input, and every expected per-layer name present.

Independent post-run verification: key sets identical, dtype `float16`, layer 7's three edited tensors bit-equal to a recomputed `cat` of the kept slices, `dense.bias` untouched. `out/T2/REPORT.md` written; note `grade.py` isn't present in this sandbox, so I couldn't run the official grader.
